_notes: Golden-set ground truth for signature-zone detection. Zones are hand-labeled approximations — where a reasonable human signer would expect to place their signature. Coordinates use top-left origin in points (72pt = 1 inch). These regions intentionally sit on the blank signing/date surfaces, not on the printed label text below them.

fixtures.description: Older IRS W-9 shipped with the repo — 4-page layout

expected_zones.note: Signature of U.S. person blank signing line after the arrow marker — above the label text
Date blank line to the right of its arrow marker — above the Date label
Signature of U.S. person line — Part II Certification block
Date field to the right of the signature
